subject.title: No guard against skill repos created outside canonical paths

question: Should OpenClaw add orphan `SKILL.md` detection outside configured skill roots, and should that detection run only in an explicit check/Doctor path?
rationale: The source gap is real, but scanning outside configured roots changes privacy, performance, false-positive, and startup-noise behavior, so implementation needs maintainer product intent.

options.title: Explicit Check/Doctor Diagnostic
options.body: Add bounded orphan detection to `openclaw skills check` or Doctor with configured-root exclusions and clear install/configure/move remediation.

options.title: Also Warn At Startup
options.body: Surface the same warning during startup, accepting extra runtime scanning and operator-visible noise.

options.title: Document Current Scope Only
options.body: Keep OpenClaw limited to configured roots and improve docs instead of adding off-root filesystem scanning.

recommendation.title: Explicit Check/Doctor Diagnostic
recommendation.body: Add bounded orphan detection to `openclaw skills check` or Doctor with configured-root exclusions and clear install/configure/move remediation.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest feature-history trail across the skill-creator and skills CLI surfaces where this product boundary would be decided.
